AuthenticationParametersApiRequest.description:
Carry how an external catalog's connection authenticates; each field belongs to one type.

OAUTH uses ``token_uri``, ``client_id``, ``client_secret`` and ``scopes``; BEARER uses
``bearer_token``; SIGV4 uses the ``role_*``, ``external_id`` and ``signing_*`` fields;
IMPLICIT uses none. The secrets are sent to the catalog, never returned, and left out of ``repr``.
AuthenticationParametersApiRequest.title: AuthenticationParametersApiRequest

AuthenticationParametersApiResponse.description: Describe how a connection authenticates; secrets are never part of it.
AuthenticationParametersApiResponse.title: AuthenticationParametersApiResponse
